networks.name: bezen_reader
networks.description: Reads what a person is protecting behind a message, before an agent answers it: what they guard, their exact words, what not to do now, whether a human must answer, and the next message.
sample_queries: Read this customer reply before we answer it: "Where did you get my email address? I never signed up for anything from you. Take me off your list."
Read this reply from a client: "When will it be ready? I told my manager it would be live this month."
Read this message from my son: "Can I sleep at Daniel's on Friday? Please don't call his mom, it's embarrassing."
Read this reply: "Sounds good, send over the NDA and we'll sign it this week."

peer_policy.note: Public agent sites are reachable like web pages; credentials and capabilities do not transfer.

agent_mcp.reason: This is a static bundle; a public MCP facade requires an application host.
